assets.name: resurrection-with-tomb-and-four-soldiers
assets.description: Christ with an entire tall flower-ended cross staff, tomb and four soldiers. Part of the Initial (openn-lewis-e-m-067-003) set.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection
provenance.title: Initial
provenance.image_rights: Public Domain Mark 1.0; item record explicitly places images in public domain

extraction.prompt: Use case: faithful historical illustration or ornament extraction. Edit the ORIGINAL supplied source region. Extract ONLY complete contacting resurrection scene inside decorated C: Christ, original red/green robe, both hands and feet, open tomb, FOUR soldiers and their original props/limbs, shared tiny green foreground turf. Crucially preserve the ENTIRE TALL ORIGINAL STAFF with its large pale-gold FLORIATE CROSS above Christ's head: three sideways/upper flowered ends and small radial ornament at their junction. It reaches close to the initial's upper blue curve. Do not replace the cross with a rounded gold knob or truncate it at head height. Preserve this faint source cross without inventing new ornaments. Remove entire decorated C/blue/red/green frame and flat gold sky, including between cross arms; pale gold original cross surfaces opaque. Keep the entire selected original subject at its original proportions: every original fingertip, toe, petal fold, serration, thin stem, curl, feather, painted highlight and print hatching. Clear the unwanted page or flat painted background and every genuine opening between subject parts. Selected pale, gold, blue or white painted or engraved subject surfaces remain opaque. Remove neighboring unrelated subjects and printed page rules, lettering or captions. Preserve only source-visible parts, including original truncated ends; no invented hidden anatomy, new leaves, new tips, extended stalks, restored details or modern replacement artwork. Do not symmetrize, beautify, redraw, sharpen, stretch or compress the hand-drawn original. Fine natural antialiased contours without stepped polygon cuts or paper halos. Genuine transparent alpha outside and within the real openings, no rectangle or checkerboard paint.
extraction.method: AI-assisted foreground extraction; transparent alpha retained, resolution capped to source region and transparent exterior trimmed.
extraction.source_pixels_redrawn: AI extraction may alter scan texture, tones or small contours; compare against the retained original source.

native_subject_size_evidence.method: Individually inspected native visible subject bounds, excluding input-region whitespace and neighbours.

extraction.subject_resolution_cap_method: Both subject axes capped to inspected native subject bounds; input-region whitespace cannot permit subject upscaling.

transparent_cleanup.method: Clear alpha <= 2/255 only more than three native pixels from alpha > 8/255; clear hidden RGB at alpha zero. Real edge alpha and visible color retained.

review.notes: Compared original regions with transparent artwork on white and dark. Correct original cat identification and full low furry tail with prey; complete floral cross staff above resurrection; contacting lower-left pair has no unrelated border knob; saints and half-figures individually separated because their bodies do not contact. Pale figures remain opaque; visible original endings retained.

assets.usage_notes: Original independent specimen with printed plate rules and page removed. AI-assisted extraction remains approximate; source bounds, actual native subject cap, original and exact prompt retained.
assets.description_before_set_naming: Christ with an entire tall flower-ended cross staff, tomb and four soldiers.
